algorithm3_consumes_algorithm2_governanc.evidence: Algorithm 3 input list declares (S, G(S), A_AI(S), repository, candidate). P1 requires S be a valid Algorithm 1 output; P2 requires (G(S), A_AI(S)) be the corresponding Algorithm 2 output. Algorithm 3 does not recompute governance.

algorithm3_supplies_RS_before_reasoning.evidence_authority: algorithm-specification.md §17 procedure (lines 5–10 precede any A4 reasoning); §18 P4; appendix-c C.7.1
algorithm3_supplies_RS_before_reasoning.evidence: Algorithm 3 completes RS(S) supply at line 10 or 3; Algorithm 4 only begins reasoning at §19 line 5, after A3 has returned. P4 explicitly requires that reasoning has not yet begun when A3 runs. Matches appendix-c C.7.1 'the governance layer supplies a rule set RS(S) to Layer 3 before any reasoning begins'.

RS_safe_conclusion_types_bounded.evidence: For S = SAFE, A3 lines 5–9 refuse supply unless every rule ρ in candidate has type(ρ) ∈ A_AI(SAFE) = {Go, Delay, DepartureTime, Duration}. SC1 confirms. ConclusionTypes(RS(SAFE)) ⊆ A_AI(SAFE) is delivered by line 10.

RS_caution_conclusion_types_bounded.evidence: For S = CAUTION, A3 lines 5–9 refuse supply unless every rule ρ in candidate has type(ρ) ∈ A_AI(CAUTION) = {Go, Delay}. SC2 confirms. DepartureTime and Duration types cannot enter RS(CAUTION).

RS_unsafe_empty.evidence: G(UNSAFE) = 0 triggers the gate-off short-circuit at A3 lines 1–3; RS ← ∅ and return. Q3 records RS(UNSAFE) = ∅ as a postcondition. SC3 confirms.

conclusion_types_subset_AAI.evidence: A3 Q1 is exactly ConclusionTypes(RS(S)) ⊆ A_AI(S). The Safety-Dominance Dependency Trace §22 records this as Link L2 — an algorithmic enforcement contract, not a filter.

invalid_RS_not_silently_filtered.evidence: When ∃ ρ ∈ RS_candidate with type(ρ) ∉ A_AI(S), A3 lines 6–8 refuse supply and return CONFIGURATION_FIDELITY_FAILURE. There is no branch that filters disallowed rules from RS_candidate and continues. Q5 preserves this and records that S is not modified and no new safety state is invented.

invalid_RS_handling_bounded_if_unspecifi.evidence: Refusal of supply is mandatory (A3 lines 6–8) and specification-complete. Runtime handling beyond refusal (whether to halt, alert, log-and-continue-without-Layer-3, require a config reload) is not authoritative and is recorded as OPEN-B3-1.

transition_consistency_requirement_prese.evidence_authority: algorithm-specification.md §17 (state/rule-set consistency note); §19 A4 P5; transition-cases-batch3.csv TC1–TC6
transition_consistency_requirement_prese.evidence: On S_old → S_new, A3 is re-invoked on S_new and the RS(S_new) it returns is what the next reasoning episode uses. A4 P5 requires the supplied RS(S) to be RS(S_current), not RS(S_prior). All six pairwise transitions TC1–TC6 pass by inspection. The invariant is preserved as specified in Batch 1 §8 (Transition Consistency Repair).

atomicity_mechanism_not_invented.evidence_authority: algorithm-specification.md §17 note; §24 OPEN-B1-8 preserved; open-decisions.csv OPEN-B1-8
atomicity_mechanism_not_invented.evidence: The state/rule-set consistency note explicitly states 'The mechanism enforcing this consistency at runtime is not prescribed here — atomic swap, immutable snapshot, locking, transactional update, serialized execution and equivalents are all admissible; the choice is bounded OPEN-B1-8 (unchanged from Batch 1). Algorithm 3 specifies the invariant, not the concurrency primitive.' No primitive is chosen anywhere in §§17–24.

algorithm3_generates_no_advisory.evidence: A3 returns only a rule set (line 2, line 10) or a CONFIGURATION_FIDELITY_FAILURE (line 8). No line invokes an inference engine or emits an AI(E) element. Q4 records this.

algorithm4_respects_participation_gate.evidence: A4 lines 1–3 short-circuit on G(S) = 0 and return AI ← ∅ without invoking the engine. Q2 records G(S) = 0 ⇒ AI(E) = ∅.

unsafe_path_skips_reasoning.evidence: For S = UNSAFE, G(S) = 0, so lines 1–3 execute; line 5 (engine.reason) is not reached. SC6 confirms: no rule firing, no advisory output.

unsafe_output_empty.evidence: A4 line 2 sets AI ← ∅ for the UNSAFE / G(S) = 0 branch. No 'Do Not Go', 'Cancel Trip' or 'Return Home' string is emitted — those would themselves be AI outputs and are not members of A_AI(UNSAFE) = ∅. State-reporting UI is outside AI(E).

participating_path_uses_only_RS_S.evidence_authority: algorithm-specification.md §19 line 5 with 'engine has RS(S) in scope and no other rule sets'; §20 P4
participating_path_uses_only_RS_S.evidence: A4 line 5 passes RS to engine.reason; the inline comment forbids any other rule sets. P4 (engine fidelity) restates the assumption: fires only rules present in the active RS(S).

engine_fidelity_assumption_explicit.evidence_authority: algorithm-specification.md §19 input list (engine description); §20 P4; §22 Link L3
engine_fidelity_assumption_explicit.evidence: A4 input list describes the engine as 'production rule symbolic reasoner satisfying the fidelity assumption (Theorem C.3 A4): fires only rules present in the active RS(S); no active rule produces a conclusion type outside RS(S)'. P4 restates it as a precondition. L3 in the Safety-Dominance Dependency Trace catalogues it as an implementation assumption.

no_posthoc_filter_substitution.evidence_authority: algorithm-specification.md §19 procedure and 'No post-hoc filter substitution' note; §17 lines 5–9 (no silent filtering)
no_posthoc_filter_substitution.evidence: A4 line 6 returns AI without a runtime re-filter against A_AI(S). The 'No post-hoc filter substitution' note explicitly rejects the pattern 'reason freely → filter output' as the primary contract. Enforcement lives at Algorithm 3 (rule-set restriction), not at Algorithm 4's output.

AI_subset_AAI_dependency_preserved.evidence: The four-link chain L1 (A_AI definition) → L2 (A3 Q1) → L3 (engine fidelity, A4 P4) → L4 (Theorem C.3) is explicit. Q1 of §20 records that AI(E) ⊆ A_AI(S) holds by construction from P3 + P4, not by runtime filter.
